subject: POC trial environment selection: hosted vs dedicated sandbox vs VPC
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@acuityhealth.com>, Tom Howard <tom.howard@acuityhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Feb 2027 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + proposed POC path (hosted / dedicated sandbox / VPC)

Hi Jenna and Tom — great to meet today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we can align on the POC flavor. Thanks for walking us through your evaluation goals.

Key success criteria you called out:
- End-to-end latency under 250ms p50 for interactive assistant flows
- Cost per 1k tokens below $0.40 for resident traffic
- Data isolation for PHI-sensitive prompts during evaluation
- Easy handoff to Prod with minimal changes

Options we discussed for trial environment:
1) Hosted trial (fastest): Redwood-hosted environment with strict data retention and per-customer isolation. No VPC required; good for quick validation and latency profiling but limited to redacted PHI or using synthetic data if you need isolation guarantees.
2) Dedicated sandbox: Reserved GPU pool for Acuity in our cloud tenancy. Predictable throughput, better isolation, supports PHI with controls. Takes ~2-3 weeks to provision depending on capacity.
3) VPC trial (hosted VPC): Private networking into your cloud with customer-managed security groups and optional KMS. Best for PHI; provisioning and network validation typically takes 3-6 weeks.

Proposed POC plan (high-level):
- Week 0: Agree success criteria + dataset (Marissa + Jenna)
- Week 1: Decide environment (Hosted vs Dedicated vs VPC) + share network contacts (if VPC)
- Week 2: Provision sandbox or enable hosted trial + baseline test scripts (Nikhil + Vivek)
- Week 3: Run evals, measure latency/cost, iterate on batching/quantization profiles
- Week 4: Finalize handoff and next steps (rollout or expanded trial)

Attachments: redwood_poc_plan.pdf (POC checklist), network_requirements.xlsx (if VPC), hosted_vs_vpc_comparison.txt

Next step: Can you confirm which environment you prefer and share the team who owns networking/procurement? I can prepare a one-page POC SOW once you confirm.

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: redwood_poc_plan.pdf (summary, checklist)

From: Tom Howard <tom.howard@acuityhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jenna Park <jenna.park@acuityhealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed POC path (hosted / dedicated sandbox / VPC)

Thanks Marissa — solid summary. A few clarifying notes from our side:
- Latency target: the 250ms p50 is for UI interactions; p95 can be higher. We'll track both.
- PHI scope: Initially we can use de-identified data for most flows, but our care management use case requires one flow that touches limited PHI (patient IDs + encounter meta).
- Compliance: procurement will want to see SOC2 evidence and KMS options if we go VPC.

For speed, we're inclined to try Hosted trial for baseline tests with synthetic/de-id data. If we see promising latency/cost, we'll escalate to Dedicated sandbox or VPC for the PHI flow. Can you confirm how easy it is to migrate the POC from Hosted -> Dedicated (are model configs and prompts portable)?

Tom
Director, Product
Acuity Health

Subject: Re: Recap + proposed POC path (hosted / dedicated sandbox / VPC)

Tom — quick tech notes on portability and constraints:
- Model/config portability: full prompts and model selection are portable. We provide an export/import for model_config + tokenizer + prompts so the same prompts run on hosted, dedicated, or VPC. There may be minor perf delta due to networking or instance types but config changes are minimal.
- Hosted -> Dedicated: migration is straightforward; we replicate model artifacts and KV cache strategies. Expect a 1-2 day validation window for perf tuning post-migration.
- VPC considerations: we need a network CIDR and firewall rules for our egress control. If you want customer-managed KMS, provision an IAM role or KMS key ARN and we'll validate access (see attached network_requirements.xlsx).
- Baseline scripts: I'll drop a lightweight runbook for latency/cost benchmarking.

I'll be available to run a quick demo of the hosted trial env this week if you want to see baseline performance.

Thanks,
Nikhil
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: hosted_vs_vpc_comparison.txt

- Marissa (Redwood): finalize 1-page POC SOW and send to procurement by EOD Monday (attached redwood_poc_plan.pdf)
- Nikhil & Vivek (Redwood): provision hosted trial keys + baseline scripts this week; share runbook and expected costs
- Jenna & Tom (Acuity): confirm dataset (de-id sample) and governance owner; loop procurement for NDA

Estimated hosted POC cost (approx): $1,200/week for the baseline usage profile (50k tokens/day) — this is to give procurement a ballpark. If usage grows, we'll re-estimate.

If procurement pushes for PHI during the POC, we'll pause and move to Dedicated or VPC; provisioning timelines below for planning: Dedicated sandbox: 2-3 weeks; VPC trial: 3-6 weeks (network validation).

Please confirm and I'll send the SOW + HubSpot link for tracking.
